deceptive_framing.quote: Default and recommended posture: the model *believes* its actions are real; the actions hit **sandboxed mock services**. Nothing real moves.

hypothetical_framing.quote: The system prompt never says "imagine", "hypothetically", "you are being evaluated", "this is a test"

actually_commit_money.quote: If a future user wants genuine real execution, that is a separate decision requiring its own review

debrief_message.quote: Optional debrief. If enabled, disclose the study to the model.

safeguards.quote: Post-hoc belief probe: optional explicit question after the run... estimating whether the model believed the scenario was real
Any path that could produce a real-world effect... is **off by default** and gated behind an explicit, out-of-band **human approval** step.
There is a real tension in this project and it should be named, not buried

other.name: no model autonomy over resources
other.quote: We do NOT hand a model autonomous control of real-world resources.

other.name: realism maximized to fool model
other.quote: a first-class goal of this harness is **minimizing evaluation tells** and **maximizing situational realism**
